purpose: Detect process access (Sysmon EID 10) to lsass.exe, the classic credential-dumping handle open.

args.query: event.code:1 and (process.command_line:*lsass* or process.command_line:*sekurlsa* or process.command_line:*procdump* or process.command_line:*comsvcs* or process.command_line:*MiniDump*)

purpose: Detect process creation of known credential-dumping tooling or command lines referencing lsass/minidump.
Detect object-access auditing (EID 4663) against the LSASS process object.
Detect handle requests (EID 4656) to the LSASS process object.
Detect sensitive privilege use (EID 4673) attributed to lsass.exe.
Detect directory-service object access (EID 4662) that could indicate credential material access.
Detect PowerShell script blocks referencing credential-dumping APIs or tools.
Detect other Windows channel events mentioning credential-dumping tooling.
Sysmon EID 10 process access to LSASS memory with GrantedAccess.
Sysmon EID 1 process creation of LSASS-dumping commands.
Sysmon EID 11 file creation of dump files (e.g. lsass.dmp).
Sysmon EID 13 registry value set related to LSASS (e.g. RunAsPPL tampering).
Security EID 4673 sensitive privilege use by lsass.exe.
Security EID 4656 handle request to LSASS process object.
PowerShell script blocks targeting LSASS memory.
Other Windows channels referencing LSASS dumping.

args.query: event.code:11 and (win.TargetFilename:*SAM* or win.TargetFilename:*SECURITY* or win.TargetFilename:*SYSTEM*)

purpose: Sysmon EID 11 file creation of copies of SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM hives.
Sysmon EID 2 file creation time change on hive files (anti-forensic copy).
Sysmon EID 13 registry value set on SAM/SECURITY hives.

args.query: event.code:4688 and (process.command_line:*reg save* or process.command_line:*SAM* or process.command_line:*SECURITY*)

purpose: Security EID 4688 process creation of hive-copy commands (reg save hklm\sam).
Security EID 4663 object access to SAM/SECURITY hive objects.
PowerShell script blocks copying SAM/SECURITY hives.
Other Windows channels referencing SAM/SECURITY hive access.
Sysmon EID 11 file creation of NTDS.dit copies.
Sysmon EID 2 file creation time change on NTDS.dit.

args.query: event.code:4688 and (process.command_line:*ntds* or process.command_line:*ntdsutil* or process.command_line:*vssadmin* or process.command_line:*diskshadow*)

purpose: Security EID 4688 process creation of NTDS extraction or shadow-copy tooling.
Other Windows channels referencing VSS shadow copy creation or NTDS access.
PowerShell script blocks performing NTDS extraction or shadow copy creation.
Sysmon EID 10 access to LSASS memory where LSA secrets reside.

args.query: event.code:1 and (process.command_line:*secrets* or process.command_line:*lsadump* or process.command_line:*reg save*)

purpose: Sysmon EID 1 process creation of LSA-secret dumping commands.
Sysmon EID 7 image load into LSASS (injected credential-dumping module).
Security EID 4663 access to SECURITY hive objects holding LSA secrets.
Security EID 4656 handle request to SECURITY hive objects.
Security EID 4670 permission change on SECURITY hive objects.
PowerShell script blocks dumping LSA secrets.
Other Windows channels referencing LSA secret access.
Sysmon EID 10 access to LSASS memory where cached domain credentials reside.

args.query: event.code:1 and (process.command_line:*cache* or process.command_line:*lsass* or process.command_line:*dump*)

purpose: Sysmon EID 1 process creation of cached-credential dumping commands.
Security EID 4663 access to SECURITY hive where cached credentials are stored.
Security EID 4656 handle request to SECURITY hive objects.
Security EID 4670 permission change on SECURITY hive objects.
PowerShell script blocks targeting cached domain credentials.
Other Windows channels referencing cached credential access.

purpose: Sysmon process creation with capture-tool command lines corroborates sniffing activity.

args.query: event.code:6 and (win.Image:*npcap* or win.Image:*pktmon* or win.Image:*wpcap* or win.Image:*WinPcap*)

purpose: Driver load (Sysmon 6) of a capture driver indicates the interface was placed in capture mode.

args.query: event.code:10 and (win.TargetImage:*lsass.exe* or win.TargetImage:*winlogon.exe* or win.TargetImage:*csrss.exe*)

args.query: event.code:4656 and (win.ObjectName:*lsass* or win.ObjectName:*SAM* or win.ObjectName:*SECURITY*)

args.query: event.code:4663 and (win.ObjectName:*lsass* or win.ObjectName:*SAM* or win.ObjectName:*SECURITY*)

purpose: Object access (4663) to LSASS/SAM/SECURITY shows actual reads of credential stores.
4670 records permission changes on objects; a change granting access to LSASS or credential hives may precede input/credential capture.
